import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pandas.arrays import SparseArray


def rec(name, thunk, defect_if_error=True):
    # defect_if_error=True: an exception is the reported defect -> NaN.
    # defect_if_error=False: an exception is the expected outcome -> 1.0, no exception -> 0.0,
    # so a case that raises on BOTH revisions never injects a NaN into the fixed probe.
    try:
        v = float(thunk())
    except Exception:
        v = float("nan") if defect_if_error else 1.0
    else:
        if not defect_if_error:
            v = 0.0
    probe(name, v)


arr_i = SparseArray(pd.array([1, None], dtype="Int64"))
arr_f = SparseArray(pd.array([1, 0, None], dtype="Float64"))

# reported example 1 and 2: Int64 NA fill
rec("int64_nafill_any", lambda: arr_i.any(skipna=False))
rec("int64_nafill_all", lambda: arr_i.all(skipna=False))
rec("int64_nafill_dense_any", lambda: pd.Series(arr_i._densify()).any(skipna=False))
rec("int64_nafill_dense_all", lambda: pd.Series(arr_i._densify()).all(skipna=False))

# reported example 3: Float64 NA fill covering all() falling through to False
rec("float64_nafill_any", lambda: arr_f.any(skipna=False))
rec("float64_nafill_all", lambda: arr_f.all(skipna=False))
rec("float64_nafill_dense_any", lambda: pd.Series(arr_f._densify()).any(skipna=False))
rec("float64_nafill_dense_all", lambda: pd.Series(arr_f._densify()).all(skipna=False))

# Series and DataFrame reduce paths reach the same gate
rec("series_int64_nafill_any", lambda: pd.Series(arr_i).any(skipna=False))
rec("series_int64_nafill_all", lambda: pd.Series(arr_i).all(skipna=False))
rec("frame_int64_nafill_any", lambda: pd.DataFrame({"A": arr_i}).any(skipna=False).iloc[0])
rec("frame_int64_nafill_all", lambda: pd.DataFrame({"A": arr_i}).all(skipna=False).iloc[0])

# reported example 4: astype to an NA fill for each numeric/timedelta subtype
for st in ["int64", "uint64", "float64", "complex128", "m8[ns]"]:
    a = SparseArray(np.array([1, 0, 0], dtype=st), fill_value=0).astype(pd.SparseDtype(st, pd.NA))
    tag = st.replace("[", "_").replace("]", "")
    rec("astype_" + tag + "_any", lambda a=a: a.any(skipna=False))
    rec("astype_" + tag + "_all", lambda a=a: a.all(skipna=False))

# reported example 5: bool subtype keeps raising on BOTH revisions -> finite indicator, never NaN
a_bool = SparseArray([True, False, False], fill_value=False).astype(pd.SparseDtype(bool, pd.NA))
rec("bool_subtype_nafill_any_raises", lambda: a_bool.any(skipna=False), defect_if_error=False)
rec("bool_subtype_nafill_all_raises", lambda: a_bool.all(skipna=False), defect_if_error=False)
